name: Thrown Weapon Savant (Combat)
body:
Your weapons always strike true.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (any thrown weapon)

Benefit(s): Whenever you make a ranged attack with a thrown weapon for which you have Weapon Focus, it gains your choice of one of the following special abilities until the beginning of your next turn; distance, returning, or seeking.
